scripts.//typecheck:apps: apps/landing only. apps/storybook is typechecked by its build (yarn storybook:build), NOT by vue-tsc: its tsconfig targets the Vite builder, so a standalone vue-tsc reports 1,671 environment errors -- 699 of them TS5097 against the repo's own mandated .ts import extensions (CLAUDE.md rule 5) and 341 TS2307 for bundler-only modules. See docs/storybook-decisions.md.
scripts.typecheck:all: tsc --noEmit -p packages/tokens/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p packages/compat/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/codemods/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && yarn typecheck:apps
scripts.//lint: packages/ AND both apps (TASK-FREE2-01). --max-warnings 0: the baseline is zero errors and zero warnings, so a new warning fails CI rather than accreting into a 'known baseline' everyone ignores. Generated output is excluded via eslint.config.js `ignores`, not CLI globs.
scripts.build: yarn workspace @dzup-ui/contracts build && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/tokens build && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/core build && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/compat build && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/codemods build && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/nuxt build && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/mcp build
scripts.validate:all: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn validate:boundaries && yarn validate:interaction-contract && yarn validate:contract-parity && yarn validate:story-status && yarn validate:story-dod && yarn validate:tokens && yarn validate:exports && yarn validate:dts && yarn validate:changelog && yarn validate:peers && yarn validate:licenses
scripts.test:e2e:functional: yarn workspace @dzup-ui/tokens build && yarn storybook:build && STORYBOOK_E2E_STATIC=1 STORYBOOK_E2E_PREBUILT=1 playwright test e2e/a11y e2e/components e2e/smoke
scripts.test:e2e:visual: yarn workspace @dzup-ui/tokens build && yarn storybook:build && STORYBOOK_E2E_STATIC=1 STORYBOOK_E2E_PREBUILT=1 playwright test e2e/visual --max-failures=1
scripts.storybook:install: yarn install && yarn workspace @dzup-ui/storybook exec playwright install chromium
